comments.body:
PR Commit message

```
The ChatRole::Tool arm only kept ToolResponse and Custom parts, so a
ContentPart::Text on a tool message was dropped without a trace and the
[tool_result, text] user turn Anthropic accepts could not be built. Serialize
the text as a text block after the tool_result blocks, in the same user message
(Anthropic requires tool_result blocks to come first).

Co-authored-by: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
```
@pcbeingused333 Good fix, thanks for clean focused PR
